settings.title: Complete Rings
settings.text: Finished engagement rings with the center stone already set. Choose one, size it, and it ships — no pairing required.

settings.title: Build with a Natural Diamond
settings.text: Choose a natural stone by cut, color, clarity and carat. We pair it with a setting and confirm every detail with you before anything is made.
settings.note: Guided one-on-one by a diamond specialist

settings.title: Start with a Setting
settings.text: Solitaires, hidden halos and three-stone mounts priced without a center stone, ready for the diamond you choose.

settings.title: Choose Your Path
settings.text: Begin with a finished ring, a diamond, or a setting — whichever you know first.

settings.title: Pair & Perfect
settings.text: We match stone and setting, and confirm every detail with you before a single thing is made.

settings.title: Crafted in Italy
settings.text: Your ring is finished by master goldsmiths and delivered fully insured, with papers.

settings.title: Build Your Ring
settings.description: Three ways to begin. Take a ring that is finished and ready, choose a natural diamond and have it set, or start from a setting you love.
settings.origin_note: Every ring lists its center stone — lab-grown or natural — on its own product page.
settings.help_text: Not sure where to start? Talk to a specialist.
